current_architecture.description: AIS-coverage-gap heuristic: classifies a scene bbox into INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE / RADAR_CONTACT_WITHOUT_AIS / VISIBLE_SOURCES_EXIST_BUT_WEAK from AIS position density alone. Does not read the SAR raster.
current_architecture.data_dependency: AIS positions within the scene bbox (same AIS source as NYAYA) — no separate CHHAYA-specific dataset required for this architecture.
current_architecture.orphaned_alternative: packages/varuna_chhaya/model/factory.py::create_chhaya_model() — an untrained, unwired LSTM trajectory regressor. Not in use. Not deleted (out of scope for a data-acquisition pass).

xview3_requirement.reason: ADR recommends keeping the wired AIS-coverage-gap heuristic (option C) until NETRA's baseline is complete and GPU/attention budget frees up. xView3 is only required if the architecture decision is revisited toward option A (real SAR pixel-detector CNN).

future_acquisition.trigger_condition: ADR revisited AND explicitly resourced as its own project phase, per ADR's 'staged path' recommendation — not folded into a data-reconciliation or acquisition pass.
future_acquisition.expected_scale: ~900GB (SAR scenes + vessel labels + ancillary bathymetry/wind layers, per xView3 challenge specs)
future_acquisition.expected_effort: comparable to NETRA's training program: new architecture, new training pipeline, GPU time comparable to NETRA baseline
future_acquisition.action_if_triggered: acquire only after an explicit operator decision; do not download speculatively
